task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate CAR to CUP, pick it up, then navigate to TABLE and place CUP on TABLE
assumptions: CAR is the only available robot
CUP is at (2.0, 2.0) and is graspable
TABLE is at (-1.9995, 2.0) and can support objects
CAR's interaction_distance of 2.0 is sufficient to reach both CUP and TABLE
rtdl: def task PickAndPlaceCupOnTable(;){ state nav_to_cup_success: bool; state nav_to_cup_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state nav_to_table_success: bool; state nav_to_table_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_to_cup_success,message->nav_to_cup_msg); check(nav_to_cup_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="CUP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-1.999530732088234,y=1.9999985766760078,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_to_table_success,message->nav_to_table_msg); check(nav_to_table_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="CUP",location_name="TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
